name: Slice Vertex Sorting via Pseudo-Angle
definition: Sorts intersection vertices of a volume slice around their centroid in counter-clockwise order using a custom pseudo-angle metric.
summary: Slice Vertex Sorting via Pseudo-Angle sorts slice intersection vertices counter-clockwise around their centroid using a custom metric, differing from other methods by relying on post-hoc geometric sorting rather than incremental traversal or proxy geometry.
